text: THE DBIM WEBSITE'S SEARCH NO LONGER ENDS AT "NO DATA AVAILABLE", AND ITS FEEDBACK FORM SAYS WHAT IT IS FOR. A search that finds nothing now names the search, offers the search library's corrected spelling ("Did you mean scholarship?") and lists the three closest matches (DBIM 3.0 §9 vii). The Feedback form opens with one sentence on its purpose and where a grievance goes instead, left-aligned (Annexure B i, §4.1.1 i). The NCSC and BJRNF partner logos drop from 125 KB and 138 KB to 22 KB each, under DBIM 3.0's 100 KB limit, with no visible change; all three website designs share them.
